title: Text Reverser & Sorter
intro: Reverse characters or lines and sort text lines alphabetically in one place.
blurb: Reverse characters or lines and sort text lines alphabetically in one place.

controls.label: Your text
controls.placeholder: Type or paste your text here…

howItWorks: Type or paste your text into the input box — there is no practical length limit.
Click one of the operation buttons (Reverse characters, Reverse line order, Sort lines A → Z, Sort lines Z → A) to transform the text instantly.
The result appears in the output box; use the Copy button to copy it to your clipboard.
All processing happens locally in your browser — your text is never uploaded anywhere.
examples: Input "stressed desserts" → click "Reverse characters" → output "stressed desserts" reversed.
Input lines of fruit names → click "Sort lines A → Z" → alphabetically sorted list.
